evidence: Modifies block and undo file storage (src/node/blockstorage.cpp and .h) to add crash-safe reobfuscation of blk*.dat and rev*.dat files.
rationale: Adds native capability to reobfuscate existing raw block and undo files to protect legacy-synced nodes against antivirus corruption without resyncing. While crash safety and resumability during chunked migration are critical block storage requirements, this is a deferrable operational maintenance feature rather than an active consensus or chainstate integrity bug fix.
